
	<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/MikeZhang/p/22601549/pyFsCount" title="发布于 2026-08-20 20:34">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">使用python统计FreeSWITCH呼叫并发</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span>操作系统 ：CentOS 7.6_x64</span></p>
<p><span>FreeSWITCH版本 ：1.10.7</span></p>
<p><span>Python版本：3.9.12</span></p>
<p><span>在FreeSWITCH作为线路接入服务器的场景下（低并发），需要定时采集呼叫的统计数据。</span></p>
<p><span>今天整理下使用python脚本统计FreeSWITCH呼叫并发的功能，我将从以下几个方面展开：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>使用api统计</span></li>
<li><span>基于ESL事件统计</span></li>
<li><span>数据推送</span></li>
<li><span>综合示例</span></li>
</ul>
<h1><span><span>一、使用api统计</span></span></h1>
<p>大致思路如下：</p>
<p>1）通过freeswitch提供的cli工具，定时调用"show calls"命令，获取数据；</p>
<p>2）解析命令行返回的数据，执行统计操作；</p>
<p>api统计可直接使用fs_cli工具，也可以使用ESL方式，这里分开描述。</p>
<h2><span><span>1、基于fs_cli实现</span></span></h2>
<p><span>通过fs_cli工具执行"show calls"命令，效果如下：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202608/300959-20260820201412116-22643233.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span>命令行输出的文本内容如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">uuid,direction,created,created_epoch,name,state,cid_name,cid_num,ip_addr,dest,presence_id,presence_data,accountcode,callstate,callee_name,callee_num,callee_direction,call_uuid,hostname,sent_callee_name,sent_callee_num,b_uuid,b_direction,b_created,b_created_epoch,b_name,b_state,b_cid_name,b_cid_num,b_ip_addr,b_dest,b_presence_id,b_presence_data,b_accountcode,b_callstate,b_callee_name,b_callee_num,b_callee_direction,b_sent_callee_name,b_sent_callee_num,call_created_epoch
f0c93f532af74c73ad55a041d612a4cf,inbound,</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">04</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">19</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">35</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1776737435</span>,sofia/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1000</span>@<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">137.100</span>,CS_EXECUTE,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1000</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1000</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">137.1</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10087</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1000</span>@<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">137.100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,,,RING_WAIT,,,,,host100,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,
64f34077</span>-45a5-46a7-a144-a1f8f864fe5c,outbound,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">04</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">19</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">35</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1776737435</span>,sofia/external/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">654321</span>@<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">137.71</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5060</span>,CS_CONSUME_MEDIA,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1000</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1000</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">137.1</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">654321</span>,,,,DOWN,Outbound Call,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">654321</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,,f0c93f532af74c73ad55a041d612a4cf,host100,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> total.</pre>
</div>
<p><span>可以看到，返回的内容是csv格式，可以通过解析csv数据，根据指定特征（比如：呼叫方向、被叫号码等）统计并发数据。</span></p>
<p><span>当然，如果无需关注呼叫特征，可直接使用如下命令获取呼叫量：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>fs_cli -x <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">show calls count</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202608/300959-20260820201510177-472204991.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span>这里采用关注呼叫特征的方案（呼叫方向、被叫号码）。</span></p>
<p>示例代码（cliCount1.py）可从如下渠道获取：</p>
<p><em>&nbsp;关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复 20260421 获取。</em></p>
<p>运行效果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202608/300959-20260820201802853-1318233718.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>2、基于ESL实现</h2>
<p><span>该模式的核心还是"show calls"这个api命令，区别在用基于ESL实现。</span></p>
<p><span>关于如何编译Python3.9版本的ESL，可参考如下文章：</span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzU4MDU1NzQ1MA==&amp;mid=2247484095&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=2a3962ef8e52e1327dcbaa4a3e2da8a5&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">自定义Python版本ESL库访问FreeSWITCH</a></span></p>
<p><span>示例代码（cliCount2.py）可从如下渠道获取：</span></p>
<p><span>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复 20260421 获取。</span></p>
<p><span>运行效果如下：</span></p>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202608/300959-20260820201857947-1392086870.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
</div>
<h1>二、使用ESL事件统计</h1>
<p><span>可基于ESL事件来统计：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">计数器累加： CHANNEL_CREATE
计数器减少 ：CHANNEL_HANGUP_COMPLETE 或 CHANNEL_DESTROY</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span>关于如何编译Python3.9版本的ESL，可参考如下文章：</span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzU4MDU1NzQ1MA==&amp;mid=2247484095&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=2a3962ef8e52e1327dcbaa4a3e2da8a5&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">自定义Python版本ESL库访问FreeSWITCH</a></span></p>
<p><span>示例代码（eventCount1.py）可从如下渠道获取：</span></p>
<p>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复 20260421 获取。</p>
<p>运行效果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202608/300959-20260820202014256-1891698920.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1><span><span>三、数据推送</span></span></h1>
<p><span>监控数据一般需要推送给监控大屏，这里通过requests库发送HTTP POST请求为例。</span></p>
<p><span>数据格式如下（json）：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">datetime</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2026-04-20 23:07:03</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">inbound</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">10087</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">outbound</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">654321</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>推送示例如下（requestsPost1.py）：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">! /usr/bin/env python</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> -*-coding:utf-8-*-</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> requests,json
url </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http://127.0.0.1:8080/CallStats</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
dtmp </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">datetime</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2026-04-20 23:07:03</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">inbound</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">10087</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">outbound</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">654321</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
}
s </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> json.dumps(dtmp)
r </span>= requests.post(url, data=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">s)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(r.text)</pre>
</div>
<p>示例服务端（httpServer1.py）可从如下渠道获取：</p>
<p>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复 20260421 获取。</p>
<p><span>运行效果如下：</span></p>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202608/300959-20260820202159164-1371855593.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1><span><span>四、综合示例</span></span></h1>
<p><span>这里基于ESL使用api实现呼叫数据统计，大致思路如下：</span></p>
<p><span>1）主线程定时调用api命令获取并发数据；</span></p>
<p><span>2）子线程执行推送操作；</span></p>
<p><span>示例代码如下（statsPushTest1.py）：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pushThrd = threading.Thread(target=doPush,args=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(gPushUrl,))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">pushThrd.daemon = True </span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">pushThrd.start()
con </span>= ESLconnection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">127.0.0.1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">8021</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ClueCon</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> con.connected:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True:
        e </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> con.api(gCountCmd)

        cmdRet </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.getBody()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cmdRet :\n{cmdRet}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        gDStats </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> count_calls(cmdRet)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">print("按方向统计被叫号码（dest字段）结果：")</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">for direction, dest_counts in gDStats.items():</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">    print(f"\n{direction.upper()} 方向：")</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">    for dest, count in dest_counts.items():</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">        print(f"  {dest}: {count} 次")</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        time.sleep(</span>3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:   
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Not connected</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>完整代码可从如下渠道获取：</p>
<p>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复 20260421 获取。</p>
<p>运行效果如下：</p>
